subject.title: Bug: Feishu DM Session Enters Infinite Loop After Subagent Announce Trigger

question: Should the remaining work be treated as a generic subagent/session runaway-run guard, a Feishu-specific queue/live-repro repair, or a close-after-proof cleanup if current main already prevents the loop?
rationale: Current main intentionally supports requester-agent completion handoff and has only partial mitigations; changing or bounding that behavior affects channel delivery, session semantics, and subagent completion policy.

options.title: Generic Subagent Guard
options.body: Add or verify bounded no-user direct-run protection in the subagent/session runtime and prove it with Feishu replay or equivalent regression coverage.

options.title: Feishu-Only Follow-Up
options.body: Keep the generic handoff unchanged and focus the remaining work on Feishu queue/session live reproduction and channel-side safeguards.

options.title: Close After Current-Main Proof
options.body: Close only if a current-main live Feishu replay shows no userless DIRECT run and no channel flood after subagent announces settle.

recommendation.title: Generic Subagent Guard
recommendation.body: Add or verify bounded no-user direct-run protection in the subagent/session runtime and prove it with Feishu replay or equivalent regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal is on the central subagent announce/delivery and Feishu-adjacent runtime surfaces.
